query: Which validated survey items or brief behavioral tasks effectively external-validate social-capital and digital-literacy indices suitable for short field surveys of students?

response.query: Which validated survey items or brief behavioral tasks effectively external-validate social-capital and digital-literacy indices suitable for short field surveys of students?
response.answer: Validated survey items include the Digital Literacy Scale (DLS) and the Digital Competence Scale (DCS) for digital literacy; the ICILS 2023 framework also provides validated measures for social-capital and digital-literacy indices.

results.content: The study aimed to develop a Likert-type measurement tool (Digital Literacy Scale, DLS) to determine the digital literacy levels of secondary school students.

results.title: Digital Competence Scale (DCS) - Scandinavian University Press
results.content: The scale is a self-assessment instrument consisting of 12 items. It represents a short instrument applicable for assessment and trainings purposes.
